entities.summary: Tomoji Ishizuka , known by his pen name written in different kanji, was a Japanese haiku poet and novelist active during the Shōwa era. Ishizuka Tomoji was a authors & novelists from Niigata Prefecture (1906-09-20, Niigata Prefecture–1986-02-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
